Keeper 1.0.0 is the first stable release of Keeper by Ashforde®: everything from the seven 0.1.0 betas plus what came after 0.1.0-beta.7. Beta copies update to it by themselves and then follow stable releases (turn on **Settings → Updates → Include beta versions** to keep getting betas). The full list is in [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/ashfordeOU/keeper/blob/v1.0.0/CHANGELOG.md).

### New since the last beta
- **Studio**: record the screen, a window or an area, then edit it into a finished video: automatic zooms from your clicks and typing, a smooth drawn pointer, backgrounds and frames for 16:9, 9:16, 1:1 and 4:5, cuts and speed-ups, a camera bubble, captions made on this computer, chapters, shortcut badges and privacy blur. Export to MP4, HEVC, WebM or GIF up to 4K and 60 fps.
- **Mail**: Important and Other inboxes, Waiting for reply with Follow up, Subscriptions with one-click unsubscribe, unified Sent and Snoozed, Send later with a Scheduled list, search across every account with answers from your mail, offline reading and changes, signatures, labels, and AI reply ideas, summaries, translation and Rewrite (on this computer if you chose a local AI; security mail never goes to it).
- **Island**: sizes from Compact to Extra large per tab, a bigger Calendar, a choice of calendars, and new Important mail dropping down with Open, Archive and Mark read. On macOS 26 the Island no longer draws a grey backdrop, and opening it never takes the keyboard.
- **Desktop widgets**: Week (events and tasks, add by typing), Timer, and a World clock with working hours and the hours everyone overlaps.
- **Computer use**: controls in other apps are read and pressed through agent-desktop (included), found again by what they are before each press, with `set_value` for fields; the system scripts remain as a fallback.

### Files, Library and Folders
- Folders work like Finder and File Explorer: subfolders first, icons, list, columns or gallery (⌘1–⌘4), a path bar, Back/Forward and the enclosing folder.
- A big library is read much more lightly: on battery only the listing runs, background reading takes about a fifth of one core, the index is written as a small journal instead of whole every few seconds, and a first start on 200,000 files uses less than half the processor time it did and peaks around 800 MB. Home shows real progress with "Speed up now".
- No more running out of memory on a first read of a big library.

### Island, Planner and tasks
- One task list for Reminders, the Planner page and the Island, with planned days, repeats, steps, projects, focus time and CalDAV sync; tasks in plain words (`!!`, `#project`, `every Mon and Thu`); Today, Week, Inbox, Upcoming, Overdue and Insights.
- Calendar events in the Island's Week and the Planner's week from every calendar Keeper reads (EventKit on a Mac, Google, Outlook, CalDAV), and Apple Notes in the Island's Notes tab.
- Island+: other apps' notifications, calls with a timer and mute, volume and brightness, coding-agent status, a focus ruler and an *Update ready* activity.

### Voice, Cues and Vibes
- Dictation anywhere, on this computer by default, with finished text (fillers removed, corrections, numbers and dates formatted, per-app tone) and editing selected text by voice.
- Meetings: microphone plus the computer's sound, live transcript, notes and action items, exports.
- Cues: notes, checklists and links tied to an app, a site, a project or a time.
- Live wallpaper, ambient sound, Vibes that switch wallpaper, theme, sound and focus together, and new widgets.

### Places & Tracks, Weather and Open with
- A private, encrypted timeline of stays, trips and activities, with imports (GPX, FIT, Google Timeline, Apple Health…), opt-in live sources and an offline-capable map.
- Weather redesigned: a summary of now, an hourly strip, a 10-day list on one scale and detail tiles.
- Places, events, addresses and numbers open in your own apps (Maps, Calendar, Mail, Messages, FaceTime and their Windows and Linux counterparts).

### System, Stage and AI usage
- System monitor: live readings in the menu bar or tray, a year of history, a process inspector, dev servers by project and about 45 coding agents detected.
- Stage: a clean screen for recording and presenting, put back exactly afterwards, even after a crash.
- Memory in use matches the system's own monitor (Activity Monitor's Memory Used on a Mac).
- AI usage: Claude and ChatGPT accounts side by side with their limits and reset times, in Usage and the Island.

### Updates, installing and security
- **Check for Updates** opens a small Software Update window with the notes, Install and Relaunch, Later and Skip this version.
- Every update must match the release's `SHA256SUMS.txt`; on a Mac it must also be signed by the same certificate as the copy it replaces.
- Releases can come out for some systems first: a copy is only offered a version that has a build for it, and the install scripts pick the newest release with your system's file.
- Security review fixes, accessibility fixes (screen readers, keyboard, contrast), and a lighter main process.

### Known limits in 1.0.0
- macOS builds are signed with Keeper's own certificate, not yet an Apple Developer ID: the first open from a download needs **Open Anyway**, and macOS asks once per update to let Keeper use its keychain item (**Always Allow**).
- Windows builds are not yet signed with a paid certificate, so SmartScreen may ask on first launch.
